# Plan: Author Episode 000 and its remaining puzzles

## Sources

`docs/game-design.md` is the authority for all mystery facts and solutions. `src/puzzle/game.ts` and `evaluate.ts` provide `attempt` for `raster` and `inquiry`. `src/narrative/dialogue.ts` selects ECHO lines. `content/puzzles/carrier.json` is Puzzle A. `src/main.ts` holds current tools.

## Content (no engine change for any story text)

- `content/episodes/episode-000.json`: puzzles `puzzle.carrier`, `puzzle.pattern`, `puzzle.archive`; `ending` lines including the design's exact `RELAY 07: RECOVERED` block; `designationPrefix` `OBS`.
- `content/puzzles/pattern.json` (`raster`): 91 bits, 7 rows of 13, spelling survey marks for 4, 1, 7 under the Rev C table. `requires: solved:puzzle.carrier`. Solution width 13, answer `417`. `knownWrong`: `714`, with feedback pointing at the manual revisions. Grants `acquired:tx.grid`.
- `content/puzzles/archive.json` (`inquiry`): `requires: solved:puzzle.pattern`. Fields: first receipt `1999-11-02`; disconnect ordered by `MOYE` (options from the roster); Relay 07 status `RUNNING` (options). Grants `acquired:tx.reconstructed`.
- Carrier gains `grants: acquired:tx.fragment`.
- `content/transmissions/`: `tx.fragment` (the pulse train, with the bits), `tx.grid`, `tx.reconstructed`.
- `content/archives/`: the press release (official date 2001-03-14), Field Manual Rev A (1997) and Rev C (1999, says it supersedes earlier revisions, with marks 4 and 7 swapped relative to Rev A), the log-format note (`YYDDD`, with a day-of-year aid), the roster separating `MOYE` from `MOYEN`, a peer-list policy saying only the director can remove a relay, `MOYEN`'s denial, the handshake specification dated January 2000. `searchOnly` with keyword `417`, `requires: solved:puzzle.pattern`: the Relay 07 logbook (several detections, only `99306` is the earliest entry matching 1421.37 MHz at -0.42 Hz/s, including a +0.42 trap and later repeats), Keel's message, and the utility ledger showing draw after the order.
- `content/characters/echo.json`: greeting, reactions per stage, escalating hints per puzzle with no solutions, and a contradiction (two memories of the manual; a memory of 07 lost to a storm against the ledger).

## Tools and engine

- `src/app/tools.ts`: builds the tool list from content and state, so it is generic by puzzle kind, not by id. `ANALYZER` (carrier), `DECODER` (raster), `ARCHIVE` (once any archive is unlocked), `INQUIRY` (inquiry), `TRANSMISSIONS` (once any is acquired), `ECHO`, `STATUS`, `SETTINGS`, `HELP`. A puzzle's tool appears only when `isAvailable`.
- `src/app/hub.ts`: `tools` becomes a function, and the menu refreshes after every tool action.
- `src/puzzle/raster-view.ts`: `RASTER WIDTH` range, a text grid of `#` and `.` in a `pre`, the bit count, `GRID REFERENCE` input, `SUBMIT`.
- `src/puzzle/inquiry-view.ts`: one labelled input or select per field. `FILE REPORT` prints only `n OF m FIELDS CONSISTENT`.
- `src/world/archive.ts` (pure): `searchArchives(archives, query)` returns entries that are not `searchOnly`, plus `searchOnly` entries with a keyword matching the normalised query.
- `src/world/archive-view.ts`: `SEARCH` input, a result list of buttons, a reading pane. Reading grants `read:<id>`, and ECHO may react.
- `src/app/ending.ts`: a scene showing `episode.ending` over the full viewscreen, then the designation. Enter returns to the hub. Shown once, on completion. The map itself arrives in the next WorkUnit.
- `src/main.ts`: slimmed to wiring. A completed player sees the designation in `STATUS`.

## Files

New: the above, `tests/unit/episode.test.ts`, `tests/unit/archive.test.ts`, `tests/e2e/episode.spec.ts`. Changed: `src/app/hub.ts`, `src/main.ts`, `src/style.css`, `content/puzzles/carrier.json`, `content/characters/echo.json`, `tests/unit/dialogue.test.ts` if its content assertions need updating, and specs whose tool numbering assumptions change.

## Edge cases

Whitespace and case in answers are already normalised. A locked puzzle's tool is not offered, and `attempt` still refuses it. A reload after completion goes to the hub without replaying the ending.

## Out of scope

Map, post-episode locations, FORGE.

# Test plan

Local commands: `npx vitest run tests/unit/episode.test.ts tests/unit/archive.test.ts tests/unit/dialogue.test.ts`, `npm run content:validate`, `npm run lint`. Browser evidence comes from the PR's `Browser tests` workflow, which runs `tests/e2e/episode.spec.ts`. Developer and tester may complete with browser evidence pending CI.

| Acceptance criterion | Verification | Owner |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Three kinds of reasoning, and earlier clues required later | `episode.test.ts`: puzzle kinds differ; `pattern` is refused before `carrier`, `archive` before `pattern`; a search for `417` finds nothing before `pattern`; the logbook's matching entry contains the carrier's frequency and drift from `carrier.json` | Developer; tester reuses |
| Raster at a width; Rev A and Rev C give different answers, only Rev C correct | `episode.test.ts`: only width 13 of 91 forms marks. The marks are read by parsing the tables out of the real archive bodies: Rev C gives `417`, Rev A gives `714`; `attempt` accepts one and returns the `knownWrong` feedback for the other | Developer; tester reuses |
| Archive search, `417` opens logbook, only a count is reported | `archive.test.ts` for search; `episode.test.ts` for `attempt` returning `consistent` with no field identity; `episode.spec.ts` for the visible text | Developer; CI |
| Multiple transmissions, several logs, ECHO per stage with a contradiction | `episode.test.ts`: at least 3 transmissions, at least 6 archives, ECHO hints and reactions for each puzzle, two contradiction lines; a scan shows no hint contains a solution value | Developer; tester reuses |
| Ending text, designation, recorded completion | `episode.test.ts`: chain of real answers via `createGame` completes and sets `OBS-` designation; ending contains the exact block. `episode.spec.ts` shows it. | Developer; CI |
| Browser test plays the entire episode through the real UI; state survives reload | `tests/e2e/episode.spec.ts`: opening to ending by UI only, then reload and verify solved state, designation and no replay | CI |

## Roles

- **Developer:** runs the local commands above.
- **Tester:** independently inspects source and content against the criteria and `docs/game-design.md`, reuses applicable passing results, repeats only for relevant changes, failures, or unresolved coverage.
- **Coordinator:** alone runs the complete required policy.

VERDICT: CHANGES_REQUESTED

| Contract area | Audit |
| --- | --- |
| Objective: complete Episode 000 and satisfying ending | Remaining tools and authored evidence are scoped; the design's final handshake revelation needs explicit content and verification (R1). |
| Mystery facts follow docs/game-design.md | Planned carrier, grid, manual revisions, date, director and relay status agree with the design. Conclusion coverage is incomplete (R1). |
| Story and solutions remain in content/ | Generic puzzle-kind tools, existing schemas and content-owned answers respect the boundary. Keep the final revelation in content too. |
| Solvable using in-game evidence | Manuals, calendar aid, roster, logbook traps and power ledger provide a credible evidence chain. Specify the search availability boundary and matching tests (R2). |
| AC1: distinct reasoning and dependent clues | Prerequisite tests and real-content raster/manual fixtures are planned; Archive availability assertions need correction (R2). |
| AC2: raster width and Rev A/C | Covered by rendered marks derived from real tables, width 13, and acceptance/rejection of 417/714. |
| AC3: searchable BBS, grid 417, count-only report | Count-only evaluator and UI checks are covered; search contract needs positive and negative cases (R2). |
| AC4: transmissions, logs, staged ECHO and contradiction | Content and fixture checks cover these; tester must inspect the actual contradictory statements rather than rely solely on line counts. |
| AC5: ending, designation, completion | Exact ending block, designation, completion and reload are planned; add the narrative payoff required by the objective/design (R1). |
| AC6: real-UI journey and reload | Covered by episode.spec.ts in Browser tests CI. Reuse tests/e2e/fixtures.ts under /signal-lost/; sandbox browser execution is correctly not required. |
| Scope, dependencies, protected paths | No new dependencies or protected edits proposed. Map/post-episode/FORGE deferral keeps this task focused on the listed acceptance criteria. |
| Validation ownership | Focused developer commands, independent tester inspection/reuse, and coordinator-only complete policy are appropriate. Browser evidence remains pending until CI passes. |

## Required revisions

1. **R1 — Specify the final revelation and how the player receives it.** PLAN.md:9,13–15,25 promises the exact terminal block and a dated handshake specification, but never specifies reconstructed transmission evidence or ECHO's comparison establishing that the client's handshake was already in the signal before the January 2000 specification. docs/game-design.md (“The idea” and “Conclusion”) makes this the mystery's final turn. Add content-owned reconstructed evidence and the comparison, identify the completion/reaction sequence that displays it before returning to the hub, and extend TEST_PLAN.md:11–12 to verify the comparison is shown in the real-UI journey. A generic ending renderer is sufficient; no new subsystem or map work is requested.

2. **R2 — Make Archive search and its verification agree.** PLAN.md:23 returns every non-searchOnly entry regardless of query, while TEST_PLAN.md:7 expects searching 417 before Pattern to find nothing. Those statements conflict when ordinary archives are available. State that the view supplies game.archives() (which applies requires), clarify ordinary-message search versus browsing behavior, and assert absence of the protected logbook rather than absence of all results. Add explicit cases: 417 cannot reveal the logbook before Pattern; after Pattern an empty or unrelated query cannot reveal it; 417 does reveal and open it. Include ordinary BBS query matching behavior and case/whitespace normalization. This makes the required grid-based access reproducible without silently changing the plan during implementation.

## Evidence and handoff

Read SYSTEM_PROMPT.md and WORKUNIT.md first, then the active PLAN.md, TEST_PLAN.md and REVIEW_EVIDENCE.md. The evidence file contains copies of the same design/test plan, with no independent previous review findings or unmerged lessons; it adds no authority or validation result.

Verified the Sources claims directly: src/puzzle/game.ts provides prerequisite enforcement, content-filtered archives/transmissions, completion and persisted designation; src/puzzle/evaluate.ts supports raster/inquiry evaluation and normalizes punctuation/case; src/narrative/dialogue.ts selects content-defined lines; src/main.ts currently wires carrier tools. src/content/schema.ts already supports the proposed content shapes. content/puzzles/carrier.json confirms the carrier frequency and signed drift. tests/e2e/fixtures.ts supplies request-intercepted production assets; package.json confirms the focused commands exist.

Area boundaries: content authors own story, evidence, prerequisites and solutions; app/views own interaction and completion presentation; pure archive search receives already-unlocked records; existing game/save modules own progression and persistence. No implementation or tests were changed or executed for this plan review. Developer should revise both plan artifacts for R1/R2; tester should independently inspect the resulting evidence chain and reuse applicable focused results. Coordinator retains trusted validation/publication ownership. The configured plan gate is none; this artifact is advisory review evidence, not a gate change or publication approval.
